findings.title: Poverty as grounded immobility
findings.claim: The needy recipient is made perceptible as a person whose poverty has stopped movement and brought the body down to earth level.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for miskin and matraba meet: arrested or settled capacity supplies the human condition, while dust and earth supply its concrete location. The supplied 30:38 relation widens that ground-level deprivation into a socially directed provision problem.
findings.reader_payoff: The recipient's need becomes visible as a loss of mobility and bodily position, so the feeding act answers a condition that has reached the ground.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading of a needy person receiving food remains recoverable. The grounded immobility is a local cross-word resonance, and it does not turn the recipient into a different social category.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run finding and the focus branch records provide the carrier contact; the poverty branch is qualified in the registry, so the embodied extension is retained with its boundary visible.

findings.title: Provision as staying capacity
findings.claim: Feeding the needy person can restore the material capacity to remain housed and socially settled, so provision reaches beyond a single meal to the ability to stay.
findings.mechanism: The focus branches for settling in a place and for provision that enables staying meet the shelter-and-staying relation supplied by 16:80. Food becomes the condition that lets the needy person occupy a place and remain in it.
findings.reader_payoff: The feeding command becomes support for a person's durable place in life, making shelter and belonging perceptible inside the recipient phrase.
findings.containment: The ayah still names a needy person as the recipient of feeding. The staying image is a contextual extension supported by the supplied relation, not a replacement for food or a claim that every need is housing.

epistemic.reason: The candidate is trusted and both focus branch descriptors are accepted; the 16:80 connection supplies contextual Arabic but no target morphology, so the extension remains qualified.

findings.reader_payoff: Support acquires a reciprocal human shape: the recipient remains materially needy while being seen as someone whose standing and companionship matter.
findings.containment: The primary material condition remains in place. Peerhood is a relational resonance of the supplied branch and connections; it does not translate the ordinary needy-person word as socially affluent or erase dependence.

epistemic.reason: The candidate and focus branch are trusted/accepted, while the cross-ayah relation supplies a qualified contextual route without target morphology.

findings.containment: The ordinary phrase remains a needy person with a dust condition. The abundance branch is retained as a contextual polarity, not asserted as the primary gloss of matraba; its form-distance remains a live qualification.

epistemic.reason: The candidate is trusted and the abundance branch is accepted, while its source support is weak and the form-distance from the focus noun limits the claim to a contextual polarity.

findings.title: The city as failed habitation
findings.claim: A bounded city can contain the needy person while failing to provide the basic spatial promise of habitation, turning private destitution into a civic failure of dwelling.
findings.mechanism: The exact HFT trace places the focus dwelling and earth carriers against the bounded city at 90:1 and the residence/emplacement evidence at 90:2. Settlement has contracted to exposed soil inside a civic enclosure, changing the before-reading of one unhoused individual into a failed habitation relation.
findings.reader_payoff: The city is newly perceptible as a promise of place, and the dust-bound person shows where that promise has not reached.
findings.containment: The focus still names a needy person with a dust condition. The city-failure image is the attributed HFT inference; the HFT alternative that 90:2 may carry legal rather than locative force remains live, and unresolved branches have no invented gloss.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT record supplies all coordinates and a before/after change, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound and three contextual branch descriptors remain unresolved.

findings.title: The recipient as counter-ledger
findings.claim: The dust-bound person becomes the material counter-ledger that tests whether a claim of spent abundance actually crossed into another person's survival.
findings.mechanism: The focus poverty and abundance branches meet the 90:5 accounting frame, the spoken claim of 90:6, its exhausted expenditure and piled wealth, and the sight question at 90:7. The recipient's dust condition turns verbal expenditure into a relation that can be checked by its social result.

findings.title: Dust as supply-collapse endpoint

findings.mechanism: The focus provision-that-enables-staying and earth carriers meet the supplied rainless-land, feeding, crisis-time, and famine-hunger traces at 90:6 and 90:14. The HFT before/after movement changes a stable poor-class reading into a possible person produced by a chain from failed supply to hunger and immobilized destitution.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus person's condition becomes a time-sensitive system failure: food reaches soil, hunger, and the capacity to remain in place through one connected repair.
findings.containment: The ordinary needy-person reading remains intact. The ecological chain is exploratory; the supplied alternative that hunger is economic or political and that the rainless-land branch is form-distant remains visible.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies every nominated role and coordinate, but the reader identity is legacy-unbound and its causal arrows are explicitly inferential.

The exact outlier trace changes the before-reading of a poor passenger into a person whose condition diagnoses and corrects the community's direction.
findings.reader_payoff: The recipient's condition becomes a practical orientation point: a community's direction is felt in how it steers toward the person stuck at ground level.
findings.containment: This cross-domain chain is an attributed analogy, not a translation of miskin or matraba. The material needy-person reading remains primary, and every unresolved branch remains without an invented gloss or facet.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT outlier supplies all six roles, coordinates, changed reading, and an explicit containment statement, but its reader identity is legacy-unbound and the branch records outside the focus are unresolved.
